title: An Investigation of the NeurIPS and ICML 2025 Position Tracks
abstract: arXiv:2608.16894v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: ML venues shape what kinds of research claims become legible to reviewers and what forms of evidence count as rigorous. The NeurIPS and ICML Position Paper Tracks were created for agenda-setting work, making their early composition worth auditing. \textbf{This paper argues that the publicly accessible 2025 reviewed pool is dominated by reformist critique, and that the track should explicitly solicit direction-setting work alongside, not in place of, the reformist critiques it already hosts well.} We audit every accessible submission to the NeurIPS 2025 and ICML 2025 Position Tracks under a pre-specified rubric, and compare the resulting pattern with a reference class of widely recognized agenda-shifting ML papers. Three-quarters of audited submissions critique an existing benchmark, evaluation, or methodology; these papers score highly on our artifact-coupling rubric, but evidentiary depth does not predict reviewer rating. translated_title: 对NeurIPS和ICML 2025立场赛道的一项调查
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.16894v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：机器学习会议塑造了哪些研究主张能被审稿人理解，以及哪些形式的证据算作严谨。NeurIPS和ICML立场论文赛道是为设定议程的工作而创建的，因此其早期构成值得审计。本文认为，公开可访问的2025年审阅池以改革性批评为主，赛道应明确征集方向设定性工作，与它已擅长的改革性批评并行，而非替代。我们根据预先制定的标准审计了NeurIPS 2025和ICML 2025立场赛道的所有可访问提交，并将所得模式与一组广泛认可的改变议程的机器学习论文的参考类别进行比较。四分之三的审计提交批评了现有的基准、评估或方法论；这些论文在我们的工件耦合标准上得分很高，但证据深度并不能预测审稿人评分。参考类别...
tldr: 本文通过审计NeurIPS和ICML 2025立场赛道的提交，发现其以改革性批评为主，并建议在保留这类工作的同时，明确鼓励方向设定性论文，以平衡赛道的议程设置作用。
en_tdlr: This paper audits NeurIPS and ICML 2025 Position Track submissions, finds a dominance of reformist critiques, and recommends explicitly soliciting direction-setting work alongside such critiques to balance the track's agenda-setting role.
